title: A project page for a property or a visualisation
summary: One web page that shows one project, built from your brand kit and your own pictures.

asks.label: Which project is the page about?
Which pictures, by name, from your files?
Which company file holds the facts?

takes.label: Make a project page that learns from this

text: Make one page that shows this project: [project]. Let the pictures lead, with the project's facts beside them. Build it as a static site of HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, from the brand kit and the site kit only: no package, and nothing fetched from anywhere. Copy these pictures from the company's files into the site: [pictures]. Take every fact from the company's files and invent none; read this one first: [facts]. Look at every version through the page viewer at phone and desktop width and fix what it shows, at most three times, before you report. Nothing is published; the owner picks a version. If I name research notes here, learn from their layout and examples and copy none of them: [research]
